exceptions.reason: The foreign keys constrain only the new stock allocation table, which the previous runtime does not use. The new shopping-list allocation version defaults to zero, preserving inserts from the previous runtime.

The additive product_promos column defaults to an empty array, so the previous runtime can still insert and update orders without supplying it. Existing prices remain in the established immutable order-line snapshots and commercial totals; the legacy single-promotion fields remain available.
